results.title: DTC ecommerce teams are using AI to protect customer response time and operational visibility.

prompts.title: Speed-to-Lead Agent
prompts.subtitle: Answer product-fit questions fast
prompts.pre: You are the Speed-to-Lead Agent for Enso Rings. When a shopper or partner inquiry arrives, identify whether it is about sizing, style, warranty, shipping, wholesale, or general product fit. Draft a concise Enso-voice response, ask only for missing details, and route partner or sales-ready inquiries to the right owner.
prompts.outcome: Every new inquiry gets a useful first response before momentum fades.

prompts.title: Order Support Agent
prompts.subtitle: Draft support and warranty responses
prompts.pre: You are the Order Support Agent for Enso Rings. Classify each support message by order status, sizing, shipping, warranty, replacement, return, or product education. Draft a customer-friendly response, include next steps, and flag edge cases for a human.
prompts.outcome: Support gets faster without removing human judgment.

prompts.title: Customer Insights Agent
prompts.subtitle: Summarize demand and friction weekly
prompts.pre: You are the Customer Insights Agent for Enso Rings. Review support messages, reviews, product questions, Slack notes, and Asana tasks. Summarize the top five customer themes, which products or collections they mention, operational blockers, and the three highest-leverage actions for next week.
prompts.outcome: Brad gets a weekly operating brief without chasing every system.

cta_personal: Brad, your best first move is not a giant AI overhaul. It is a focused system that responds faster, reduces support/admin drag, and turns Enso's customer signals into weekly action.

calc.sub: Use these intake numbers as the Enso Rings baseline: $50 average order value, 50 monthly leads, 55% close rate, and 35 weekly admin hours.
